info.title: Airline Management API
info.description:
OpenAPI definition generated from the legacy VB.NET WinForms application `AirlineManagement_VBNetLegacy`. This document describes the endpoint migrated from `EditProfileForm.BtnUpdate_Click`, which updates the logged-in user's profile (email, full name and optionally password).

**Legacy behaviour preserved:**
- Email, full name and password are validated with the same rules as `ValidationHelper`.
- Password is optional; when blank, the existing password is kept.
- Passwords are stored as uppercase hexadecimal SHA-1 digests of the UTF-8 bytes, as in `UserRepository.HashPassword`.
- The user is identified by the authenticated session (`SessionManager.CurrentUser`), not by a request parameter.

/users/me/profile.description: Represents the profile of the authenticated user.

put.description:
Replaces the authenticated user's email and full name and, when a password is supplied, replaces the password.

Mirrors legacy `EditProfileForm.BtnUpdate_Click`:
1. `email` and `fullName` are trimmed, then validated (`ValidateEmail`, `ValidateFullName`).
2. If `password` is not blank, it is validated (`ValidatePassword`).
3. If any validation fails, the request is rejected with HTTP 400 and all messages are returned.
4. Otherwise the user row is updated (`UserRepository.Update`). If a password was supplied, it is stored as `UserRepository.HashPassword(password)` via `UserRepository.UpdatePassword`.
5. The session user's email and full name are refreshed.
6. Any unexpected failure returns HTTP 500 with the message `An error occurred: <message>`.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token identifying the logged-in user. Replaces the legacy `SessionManager.IsAuthenticated()` check.

requestBody.description: Profile values to save. `email` and `fullName` are always applied; `password` is applied only when it is not blank.

email.description: New email address. Trimmed before validation. Must match the legacy email pattern (`ValidateEmail`).

fullName.description: New full name. Trimmed before validation. Must be 2 to 255 characters (`ValidateFullName`).

password.description: Optional new password. When null, empty or whitespace only, the existing password is kept. When provided, must be at least 6 characters (`ValidatePassword`). Stored as an uppercase SHA-1 hex digest.

200.description: Profile updated successfully. Corresponds to the legacy success message `Profile updated successfully!` followed by closing the form.

username.description: Login name (not editable through this endpoint).

role.description: User role, for example `admin` or a regular user role.

400.description: Validation failed. Corresponds to the legacy `lblError.Text = String.Join(vbCrLf, errors)` path. No changes are saved.

errors.description: Validation messages, in the legacy order: email, full name, password.

errors: Full name must be between 2 and 255 characters.

401.description: Unauthorized. The request has no valid session. Corresponds to the legacy `Please login first.` check.

403.description: Forbidden. Not used by the legacy code; reserved for token-scope violations in the modern stack.

404.description: User not found. Corresponds to the legacy `User not found.` error when the logged-in user no longer exists in the database.

500.description: Unexpected failure while saving. Corresponds to the legacy `An error occurred: <message>` text.

message.description: Error text. The legacy format is `An error occurred: <exception message>`.
message.example: An error occurred: 23505: duplicate key value violates unique constraint

bearerAuth.description: Authenticated session token. Replaces the legacy in-memory `SessionManager.CurrentUser`.
